A lot of graphical changes and updates along with bugfixes and mechanical improvements.
One more set of playtesting and then it is ready for dem.

notes.title: More menus
notes.content:
Added more options in the menu including:
- look sensitivity.
- key rebinding.

Menus work with keyboard navigation now.

Also added proper playtesting statistic tracking.
- what level the player gets to and where they loose.

notes.title: Updates and fixes.
notes.content:
- Removed the combat ring. Now enemies can spawn anywhere and you are not restricted to staying inside the ring.
- Enemies no longer drop tris consistently. It is a rare drop from them now.
- Most of the tris is now gathered from ore found throughout the stage.
- The portal at the end of each level needs to be unlocked now by defending it from enemies.
- Adjusted the balancing of weapons to try to make it fun to use all of them.
- Various bug fixes.

notes.title: NPC and movement
notes.content:
- Added an NPC that trades heart gems to increase max hp or to get tris.
- Adjusted player acceleration to give a slightly stronger control.

notes.title: Shop and Collision
notes.content:
- Updated the shop area with improved graphics. Also added facilities to house future NPCs.
- Changed the way the player detects the ground in order to fix some collision bugs.
